final:
pad2(n: int) -> str =
  pre n >= 0 and n < 100
  post out.char_count() == 2
  ex pad2(5) == "05"
  ex pad2(42) == "42"
  let tens = n // 10
  let ones = n % 10
  "\(tens)\(ones)"

stamp(ts: int) -> str =
  post out.char_count() == 8
  ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
  ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
  ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
  ex stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
  let day_secs = ts % 86400
  let h = pad2(day_secs // 3600)
  let m = pad2((day_secs % 3600) // 60)
  let s = pad2(day_secs % 60)
  "\(h):\(m):\(s)"
